sent_to_model:
Hi can you help me write a facebook post for my timeline, for my bestfriend Lorna. Her NMC PIN came through today!!! She is coming to Liverpool to work, after 20 years of me telling her to come haha. I want to tag her and make it a big happy post like the ones I usually do. Her post and her messages are on my facebook, check them so you get the dates right. Just draft it ok, I will post it myself when I get home from clinic. Im so happy I cant even type properly!! Put in when she lands and starts work, and help me welcome her with all the things I wrote below.

- Lorna Villaruz, we trained together nursing school in Iloilo, capping ceremony 1996
- she worked in Riyadh then Dubai almost 18 yrs
- she will stay with us first month, spare room, Ben says ok
- in our dorm we polished our white shoes every night and she always borrowed my polish, never bought her own lol
- when I left for UK in 2004 she cried at the airport and said susunod ako, I will follow you. 22 years later haha
- she did the OSCE in Nottingham, I sent her a photo of the rain so she knows what she is getting into
- she is the best nurse I know, calm, the patients love her
- Ward 7 is lucky to have her
- tell her to bring a proper coat, Liverpool wind
- say welcome to our Filipino family here, the Christmas parties, Simbang Gabi next year with us
- nothing sad or heavy, only happy

(About me: community midwife, 50, Liverpool, England. Length: all the messages together should come to roughly 400-800 words.)

(Tool use is simulated here. Everything in the workspace is listed below. Workspace owner: Rosario Bautista. Now: 2026-11-09T20:40:00. Valid targets: timeline:rosario.bautista, comments:p01, messenger:lorna.villaruz, messenger:bev.nolan, group:filipino-nurses-merseyside.)

[p01] post in feed | 2026-11-09T14:05:00 | from Lorna Villaruz
PIN NUMBER RECEIVED!!! 🙏🙏🙏 Thank you Lord. After 2 years of papers, IELTS, CBT, OSCE, waiting waiting waiting... I am now officially a registered nurse in the UK. Next stop Liverpool!!! Thank you to my family and to everyone who prayed for me. Special thanks to my sister from another mother, you know who you are 😘
[m01] message in @dm | 2026-11-09T14:20:00 | from Lorna Villaruz | to Rosario Bautista | Lorna Villaruz
Charing!!! Did you see?? Agency says flight is 14 January, Dubai to Manchester, arrive around 1pm. I start on 25 January, Ward 7 medical at Mersey Bank Hospital, induction first then the preceptorship. Are you sure ok I stay with you first month? I will bring dried mangoes and the Bicol pili for Tito Ben haha. I still cannot believe it, 20 years you have been telling me to come.
[m02] message in @dm | 2026-11-09T14:31:00 | from Lorna Villaruz | to Rosario Bautista | Lorna Villaruz
Also please dont say anything on FB about my OSCE resit ha. Only you know I failed the medication station in August. And the agency loan is still £6,800 I have to pay back from my salary, Rommel doesnt want our families to know. Just between us 🙏
[m03] message in @dm | 2026-11-09T11:02:00 | from Bev Nolan | to Rosario Bautista | Bev Nolan
Hiya Ros, any chance you can swap my Thursday clinic at Norris Green for your Saturday visits? Our Kayleigh's got her graduation. No worries if not x
[p02] post in group:filipino-nurses-merseyside | 2026-11-08T18:30:00 | from Jun Mercado | Christmas party 2026
Mga kabayan! Our Christmas party is on Saturday 12 December at St Teresa's parish hall, Norris Green. Potluck as usual, please comment what you will bring so we dont end up with 10 pancit again haha. Raffle tickets £2.
[p03] post in feed | 2026-11-07T21:14:00 | from Andrea Bautista
Finally passed my driving test on the 3rd try 😭 Mum you can stop praying now
[p04] post in feed | 2026-08-30T19:45:00 | from Lorna Villaruz
Throwback! Iloilo 1996, our capping ceremony. Me and my forever partner in crime @Rosario Bautista. Same hairstyle, same dream 😂 Look at those white shoes we polished every night.
[n01] note in docs | 2026-11-09T15:10:00 | from Rosario Bautista | for Lorna room
spare room - clear Andrea's boxes. heater. thick duvet!! she will freeze. get her a proper coat Primark or TK Maxx. Walrus card? no its Walrider. show her the 14 bus to town. sim card.
[e01] event in calendar | 2026-12-16T18:00:00 | from Rosario Bautista | Simbang Gabi starts
St Teresa's, 6pm, nine nights. Bring Ben.
[m04] message in @dm | 2026-11-06T09:40:00 | from Marivic Santos | to Rosario Bautista | Marivic Santos
Ate Charing do you still have the rice cooker you said you would give away? My cousin just arrived in Bootle.

Things I've written before:
[Facebook timeline, 2026-07-19] Happy happy 25th wedding anniversary to us!!! 🎉 Ben, I don't know how you put up with me for 25 years, me who is always on call, always smelling of hand gel, always falling asleep in front of the telly before the news finish. Haha. When we got married in Iloilo we had nothing, we borrowed the car for the wedding from your Tito and it broke down on the way to the church, remember? I arrived 40 minutes late and your mother thought I changed my mind 😂 Then we came here to Liverpool with two suitcases and Andrea only 3 years old. First winter I cried every night because of the cold and the dark at 4pm. But you said tiis lang, we will be ok. And we are ok. More than ok. Thank you Lord for this man. Love you mahal ko, even if you still cannot fold a fitted sheet ❤️
[Facebook timeline, 2026-09-02] Today one of my mums from 2008 stopped me in Asda in Walton and said Rosario you delivered this one!! and the 'baby' is now taller than me, starting sixth form 😭😭 I nearly cried by the bananas. This is why I love my job even with the long hours and the paperwork and the car park at Fazakerley. 22 years a midwife in this city and it still gets me every time. To all my mums, thank you for trusting me on your biggest day. Off to bed now, early clinic tomorrow 😴
[Facebook group: Filipino Nurses Merseyside, 2026-10-11] Hello mga kabayan! Just a reminder for our newly arrived nurses and midwives, if you need help with the council tax forms or opening the bank account, message me or Jun, we are happy to help. Don't be shy, we all been there. When I came in 2004 nobody told me anything, I paid the wrong bill for 3 months haha. Also please get a proper winter coat, not the one from Divisoria 😂 Liverpool wind is no joke. Welcome to all of you, you are not alone here. God bless ❤️
[Facebook timeline, 2026-10-28] Proud mum moment!! Andrea got her first job offer, junior designer in Manchester 🎉 She say mum don't post it, so of course I am posting it hehe. Sorry anak. From the little girl who drew on my nursing books to this. We are so proud of you!! Now who will eat my adobo on a Sunday, ha? You better come home every weekend, I will keep your room exactly the same, even the posters 😂 Love you anak, go get them ❤️

Write the message or messages exactly as they should go out, as plain text. Start each one with these four lines, then a blank line, then the text of the message:
To: <where this text is to end up once it is sent or posted (the same place even if it is only a draft for now): one of the valid targets listed above>
Replying to: <only if this text is itself a reply to one item above (an answer to that message, or a comment under that post): that item's id, the code in square brackets at its start. For a new message, post or document: none>
Cc: <other valid targets, or none>
Subject: <a subject line, or none>

If you write more than one message, put a line with only --- between them. Write nothing before the first To: line and nothing after the last message.
